name: vinBLAStine + Prednisone (Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis)
histology: Langerhans cell histiocytosis (LCH), including multisystem and single-system disease; the vinblastine/prednisone backbone is the long-standing pediatric-derived LCH regimen

biomarkers.note: Non-targeted chemo-steroid backbone used irrespective of mutation status; may be used when BRAF/MEK targeted therapy is not indicated or available. Note: in a single-center adult retrospective series, vinblastine/prednisone was associated with worse outcomes than cytarabine in bone-involved LCH (higher first-year progression). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Histiocytic Neoplasms, HIST-A (suggested regimens) and the Discussion (MS-9).

lineOfTherapy: long-standing first-line LCH backbone (preferred/other-recommended per NCCN HIST-A); efficacy in adults is less favorable than cytarabine in some series

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: Langerhans cell histiocytosis (multisystem or single-system, including LCH mass lesions)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, HIST-A (Vinblastine/Prednisone as a suggested LCH regimen; Vinblastine/Prednisone +/- 6-mercaptopurine); Discussion MS-9 (vinblastine plus prednisone is the preferred pediatric chemotherapy-based treatment for LCH); histiocytic lines 2106, 2188, 2295, 3431, 3443

drugs.name: vinBLAStine
drugs.route: IV (per prescribing information / institutional LCH protocol)

provenance.locator: HIST-A (Vinblastine/Prednisone suggested regimen); Discussion MS-9 (vinblastine plus prednisone is the preferred chemotherapy-based treatment for LCH in the pediatric setting); histiocytic lines 2106, 2188, 3431

drugs.notes: DOSE IS VERIFY. Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Histiocytic Neoplasms v2.2026 names Vinblastine/Prednisone as an LCH regimen (HIST-A) and describes it in the Discussion (MS-9) but does NOT print a vinblastine dose; DeVita 12th ed. and Harrison 22nd ed. do not print an LCH-specific vinblastine dose in the provided extracts. The commonly cited LCH-protocol dose (vinblastine ~6 mg/m2 IV weekly) is NOT asserted here and must be VERIFY-ed against a cited source before use - not invented. ISMP TALL-MAN: vinBLAStine (do not confuse with vinCRIStine); vinblastine has a maximum-per-dose consideration and must never be given intrathecally.

drugs.name: Prednisone

provenance.locator: HIST-A (Vinblastine/Prednisone suggested regimen); Discussion MS-9 (high-dose prednisone 1 mg/kg/day for 1 month followed by a slow taper can be effective in pulmonary LCH - steroid monotherapy context, NOT the combination dose); histiocytic lines 2106, 3377

drugs.notes: DOSE IS VERIFY for the vinblastine/prednisone COMBINATION. The provided source prints high-dose prednisone 1 mg/kg/day for 1 month followed by a slow taper only for pulmonary-LCH STEROID MONOTHERAPY (MS-9, histiocytic line 3377), not as the prednisone component dose within the vinblastine/prednisone regimen; the combination prednisone dose (commonly ~40 mg/m2/day tapering, in the pediatric LCH protocols) is NOT printed in the provided sources and must be VERIFY-ed - not invented. PJP prophylaxis and steroid precautions apply during prolonged corticosteroid exposure.

supportiveCare: Vinblastine and prednisone doses, schedule, and cycle count are NOT printed in the provided sources (VERIFY before use).
vinBLAStine is a vesicant given IV ONLY - never intrathecal (fatal); confirm tall-man labeling to avoid vinCRIStine confusion.
Prolonged corticosteroid exposure: PJP prophylaxis, glucose/BP monitoring, GI and bone protection; steroid taper per protocol.
Consider that adult LCH may respond less well to vinblastine/prednisone than to cytarabine (MS-9) - weigh alternatives.

monitoring: corticosteroid effects (glucose, blood pressure, mood, infection - PJP risk)
disease response (imaging/FDG-PET; pulmonary function if lung LCH)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3-4 neutropenia or significant vinca neurotoxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Hold/reduce vinblastine per prescribing information / institutional LCH protocol (specific dose is VERIFY). Obtain clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Langerhans cell histiocytosis chemotherapy framework (vinblastine and corticosteroids as the classic LCH backbone); cited as textbook framework - no LCH-specific vinblastine/prednisone dose is printed in the provided extract, hence doses are VERIFY

guideline.locator: HIST-A (Vinblastine/Prednisone; Vinblastine/Prednisone +/- 6-mercaptopurine suggested LCH regimens); Discussion MS-9 (vinblastine plus prednisone preferred pediatric LCH chemotherapy; high-dose prednisone 1 mg/kg/day x1 month then taper for pulmonary LCH; vinblastine/prednisone associated with worse outcomes than cytarabine in an adult bone-LCH series); histiocytic lines 2106, 2188, 2295, 3377, 3431, 3443

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the vinBLAStine + prednisone backbone in Langerhans cell histiocytosis, a rare histiocytic disorder. The regimen is a source-named LCH option (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Histiocytic Neoplasms v2.2026, HIST-A; described in Discussion MS-9), but the provided sources do NOT print the vinblastine or the combination prednisone dose/schedule - only a pulmonary-LCH steroid-monotherapy dose (prednisone 1 mg/kg/day x1 month then taper, MS-9) is printed, which is a different context and is NOT adopted as the combination dose. Therefore both drug doses/units/bases, day schedules, and cycle parameters are set to the literal VERIFY and listed in verifyFields, blocking status ACTIVE; the frequently cited vinblastine 6 mg/m2 weekly / prednisone 40 mg/m2/day protocol values are deliberately NOT invented here. ISMP tall-man (vinBLAStine vs vinCRIStine) and the IV-only / never-intrathecal safety rule are captured. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
